# nsh-input

`src/input.rs` is longbridge/nsh `crates/nsh-core/src/input.rs` at 6fa6368f,
unchanged (Apache-2.0, LICENSE-APACHE). `src/shim.rs` holds the nsh-core
definitions it names, copied unchanged with their source lines: `EventKind`
and its list, `EventMask`, `PanActivation`, `GestureValues`, `ViewKind`,
`keymap::{Modifiers, Key}`, `NodeId`, `ROOT_ID` and `EdgeInsets`. Geometry
and the state bits come from the vendored nsh-tailwind. Nothing is patched.
